author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Formafantasma
summary: A design studio in Amsterdam and Milan since 2009. It begins projects not with object form but with research into raw materials, supply chains, ecology, politics and material history.

hero_image.alt: A work table of raw fibre and cordage, mineral and timber samples, colour chips and an open reference volume, a figure working at the far end.
hero_image.caption: The project begins at the raw material, not at the finished form.
